name: koti-mcp
description: Scaffold Bun + Express + MongoDB TypeScript API projects with RBAC, JWT auth, and Swagger docs through natural language.
long_description: Koti CLI MCP server exposes 8 tools for creating and managing TypeScript API projects: scaffold complete projects, define Mongoose models with optional CRUD endpoints, create controllers/services/middleware/enums, manage RBAC permissions, and seed databases. All through AI-assisted natural language instead of interactive CLI prompts.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Scaffold a complete Bun + Express + MongoDB TypeScript API project

tools.name: create_model
tools.description: Create a Mongoose model with optional CRUD endpoints and RBAC tasks

tools.name: create_controller
tools.description: Create an empty TypeScript Express controller

tools.name: create_service
tools.description: Create an empty TypeScript service class

tools.name: create_enum
tools.description: Create a TypeScript enum with string or number values

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Add an RBAC permission task to the Task enum

tools.name: seed_database
tools.description: Seed MongoDB with default roles and admin users

resources.name: project-structure
resources.description: View the file tree of a Koti project

resources.name: models-list
resources.description: List all Mongoose models in the project

resources.name: tasks-list
resources.description: List all RBAC tasks in the Task enum

prompts.name: scaffold-api
prompts.description: Guided workflow to create a new API project with models and RBAC

prompts.name: add-crud-model
prompts.description: Guided model creation with full CRUD and permissions
